desc: Implement Fenwick tree (BIT) for computing initial inversion count inv(0) in O(N log M).
Build pos array: for each value v in 0..M-1, collect positions i (1-indexed) where A[i] == v.
Precompute change[v] for each value v in 0..M-1 by iterating through positions of each value and applying the formula change += 2*p - N - 2 + c - 2*prefix.
Compute ans[0] = inv(0), then for k=1..M-1, ans[k] = ans[k-1] + change[(M-k) % M].
Output ans[0..M-1] each on a new line.
Handle edge cases (M=1, N=1) and test with provided samples.
